original_card.question: Can one precisely specified helper-mixing word satisfy a replacement for the inherited H2/K interface?
methods: Derive a replacement interface lemma and price its implementation.
Seek an exact dirty-input or chronological-cut counterexample to the proposed replacement.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A full boundary contract and paid profile; unchanged scalar counts alone are insufficient. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Compare the two false H2/K flags with the unchanged paid profile in its README.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write one replacement H2/K implication for a single helper-star operation, then try to falsify it on dirty inputs.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A legitimate replacement could admit a cheaper bit circuit; scalar savings alone do not alter the selected moment.
allowed_variations: Choose one helper-star or quartet instance; narrow to one boundary implication.
scope_change_triggers: Changing only source count or scalar addition count without an interface argument.

actual_scope: Boundary (h,y)->(T h, y+K h) with dirty inputs, T in GL_H(F2), unit-cost directed XORs, fixed labels. (1) Written every-word lemma: any word of length L whose product lies in P_{H,Y} yields an explicit restricted word of length L - f_v + c(w) computing the same map, with an explicit contamination charge c and no hypothesis that the target block is invertible. (2) Exact 3+3 decision over the 85,504 exits with T != I: no strict feedback advantage, common minimum histogram 1:6 2:96 3:744 4:3594 5:11463 6:23948 7:29259 8:15438 9:956. (3) Five-register shapes 2+3, 3+2, 4+1: no strict advantage for the 333,552 twisted (T != I) exits (320 + 10,688 + 322,544); the run also covers 144 settled T=I shears in those shapes and the 16 settled 1+4 exits, 333,712 in total. Positive control: in the same five-register model exactly 120 non-exit elements of P (60 in P_{2,3}, 60 in P_{3,2}, all with target block D != I) have d_full = d_P - 1, and Corollary 2 holds on a minimum word of each; so the exit condition D = I is load-bearing.
scope_change_reason: The card asks whether one specified helper-mixing word satisfies a replacement for the inherited H2/K interface. This package answers the replacement contract's feedback question (PR1868 question 3) for twisted exits: an every-word contamination-charge lemma plus exact 3+3 and five-register decisions. It admits no H2/K word and changes no paid profile.
bottleneck_link: Side result for the bit-helper-contract line (PR1868 question 3, fixed exits only): in PR1306's model, target-to-helper feedback gives no gain at any twisted exit of the 3+3 shape (the case PR2494 left open) or of the five-register shapes 2+3, 3+2, 4+1 (with PR2494's H+Y <= 4 census, every twisted shape with at most five registers). Not closed: twisted 2+4, 4+2, 5+1 and larger shapes; the actual seed02 D boundary (at least 3 helpers and 99 targets), where only Corollary 2's necessary condition (a non-clean, i.e. contaminated or singular, read with c >= f_v + 1) applies; C-absorption pricing; twisted-versus-restored exits. No kappa effect either way: the bit side does not bind (r439-twisted-star-absorption-seed02).
stop_rule: Submit only if some exit has a cross-checked strict feedback advantage, or the lemma is written for every word with no target-block invertibility hypothesis, mechanically corroborated, with the finite 3+3 decision as corroboration (met by the latter).
evidence: PROOF.md (written lemma and corollaries); verify.py (stdlib: construction on 6,628 words, two per element of every P_{H,Y} with n<=4, 8,400 random P-words n<=8, 2,800 free words with the per-gate invariant only; stdlib column-major 3+3 MITM via independent33.py with restricted balls asserted inside P_{3,3}; five controls); numpy_crosscheck.py (numpy==2.5.4: dense P_{3,3} BFS + row-major B4xB4 MITM; dense five-register census; construction on one greedy minimum word per five-register exit, 333,712 words, 35 of which (all 4+1) have a non-clean read with c = f_v + 1, so those exits are decided by the census, not the lemma).
author: Sagar Thakrar (thakrarsagar)
ai_assistance: Substantial AI assistance from Claude (Anthropic, Claude Opus 5.5) in research, code, checking and writing; reviewed only by AI passes in the same loop, no independent human review.

open_questions.question: Is there a local rewriting rule that turns a minimum word with a non-clean read into a restricted word of the same length, at least for one-target (Y = 1) twisted exits at every H? Such a rule must use D = I, because 120 non-exit five-register elements of P have a strict feedback gain.
open_questions.why_it_matters: c <= f_v already fails for some minimum words (the 35 greedy 4+1 words have c = f_v + 1, yet their exits have equal-length restricted words), so the lemma alone cannot extend the decision; such a rule would extend it beyond five registers.
open_questions.first_step: For each of the 35 greedy 4+1 words, align it with a restricted minimum word of the same length and extract the local rewrite.
open_questions.blocked_by: No candidate rule yet; the census certifies lengths, not rewrites.

open_questions.question: Does a strict feedback advantage first appear at seven registers (3+4 or 4+3 twisted exits)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Only a concrete word beating a certified restricted minimum would reopen the feedback question for a replacement helper contract.
open_questions.first_step: Use Corollary 2 to restrict the search to words with a non-clean (contaminated or singular) read and charge at least f_v + 1, rather than a blind census.
open_questions.blocked_by: No favourable candidate; a larger negative census alone is not justified by this result.
